The TODO grammar has no files of its own: it is injected into comments and
into plain text, so this sample is a .txt file and the markers below are
highlighted by the injection rather than by a grammar of its own.

TODO: the marker itself is what gets scoped, not the line.
FIXME: a second marker, on its own line.
@TODO an at-sign in front is allowed.

Every recognised marker, one per line:

TODO
FIXME
CHANGED
XXX
IDEA
HACK
NOTE
REVIEW
NB
BUG
QUESTION
COMBAK
TEMP
DEBUG
OPTIMIZE
WARNING

Markers only match at a word boundary, so none of these is one:

xTODO
TODOs
NOTEBOOK
subTODO

A radar link is scoped too: <rdar://problem/1234>
